bio: Dre50 is a Montego Bay, Jamaica-origin artist on the CWI roster, blending Jamaican rhythms with R&B (CWI's Global Alt-Rap Protocol). His single Pix (released 2026-01-07, 2:31) credits Black Lansky as co-writer alongside Andre Rowe, with composition by Elevated and Friends, and ℗ 2025 Cumulative Web Inc — independently confirmed via distributor receipts (UPC, ISRC) and Deezer metadata. Molly is its own 2022 single, not part of the Pix single.
